sections.text_helper: Section 9.8.14 "RCC APB3 peripheral reset register (RCC_APB3RSTR)" in chapter 9 (Reset and clock control (RCC)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 295.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x080
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:12 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 11 LPTIM1RST: LPTIM1 reset
Set and reset by software.
0: LPTIM1 not reset (default after reset)
1: LPTIM1 reset
Bits 10:7 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 6 LPUART1RST: LPUART1 reset
Set and reset by software.
0: LPUART1 not reset (default after reset)
1: LPUART1 reset
Bits 5:2 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 1 SBSRST: SBS reset
Set and reset by software.
0: SBS not reset (default after reset)
1: SBS reset
Bit 0 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
